body:
The Tasks tab's Feature and Milestone columns currently hold `link_select` controls, so the table can change both links. Make the table read-only: show each loaded record's title as plain text, fall back to its id when not loaded, and show `—` when there is none. Keep the columns and their sorting; editing links stays in the task detail.

**Tests:** rows with a feature, milestone, both and neither render text and no select; the fallback id and empty state; sorting by Feature and Milestone is unchanged; opening and paging rows still work.
title: tasks: table links read-only
